channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Taylor Swift Fan Released from Prison
item.description: An individual, described as an unlikely Taylor Swift fan and referred to as 'Patient Zero' in some coverage, has been released from prison. The specific details of their conviction or the circumstances of their release are not provided in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Murder charges withdrawn due to lost evidence in 1988 cold case
item.description: Murder charges against an individual in the 1988 cold case death of Byron Carr have been withdrawn because crucial evidence from the investigation was lost. The Crown Attorney's Office stated that the loss of this evidence means there is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Court Orders New Trial in Fatal Lake Ontario Boat Crash
item.description: The Court of Appeal has ordered a new trial for a man previously acquitted in a double fatal boat crash on Lake Ontario. The initial trial was judged by a judge alone. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Fatal Collision in Scarborough Injures Two Others
item.description: A 68-year-old woman died following a collision in Scarborough, with two other individuals sustaining injuries. Police are investigating the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Writer Denies AI Authorship After Novel Pulled from Prize List
item.description: Haitian-Canadian writer Thélyson Orélien has denied that his best-selling debut novel was written by artificial intelligence, following its withdrawal from the prestigious Goncourt prize list. The book was removed after AI detection… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Baby P's Mother Seeks Parole, Admits Manipulative Nature
item.description: Tracey Connelly, the mother of Baby P, has admitted to being 'manipulative and opportunistic' as her bid for parole continues. Her parole hearing has resumed. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Lebanon Seizes Explosives Truck, Hezbollah Faces Outrage
item.description: Lebanese authorities seized a truck carrying explosives at a checkpoint, prompting an investigation vowed by the Prime Minister. Hezbollah is facing public outrage in Lebanon over the incident and alleged cash payouts. The group has also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Early Prisoner Releases Raise Concerns Over Tagging Failures
item.description: Hundreds of prisoners released early across England and Wales are not being electronically tagged, according to MPs. Clive Efford stated that Serco has failed to source enough tags, leading to difficulties for police and probation services… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Texas AG Paxton Attended Dubai Party With Fugitives, Report Says
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton reportedly attended a New Year's Eve party in Dubai on December 31, 2024, with two American men facing federal criminal charges in the U.S., according to a report by The Wall Street Journal. One of the men… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: CJP Leaders Detained at Jantar Mantar, FIR Filed
item.description: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were detained by Delhi Police at Jantar Mantar after allegedly climbing over police barricades to enter the protest site. The incident occurred after they unfurled a tricolor. CJP founder Abhijit… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: West Bengal CM Mamata Banerjee Attacked During Durga Puja Event
item.description: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee's sari was pulled by a young woman during the inauguration of a Durga Puja pandal in Kalighat, Kolkata. The assailant reportedly brought a weapon concealed in her sari. MP Dola Sen has filed a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Woman Allegedly Attempts Attack on Mamata Banerjee Outside Residence
item.description: A woman allegedly abused and attempted to attack West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee outside her Kalighat residence. The Trinamool Congress (TMC) alleged that the incident, which occurred as Banerjee was returning from a Durga Puja… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Man Dies After Riyadh Airport Attack
item.description: An Indian man from Kamareddy, Telangana, has died following an attack at Riyadh's King Khalid Airport. He was critically injured and in intensive care before succumbing to his injuries. The incident occurred at the airport in Riyadh. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: BMC Notices Contractor Over Soil Use on Mumbai Coastal Road
item.description: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has issued a show-cause notice to a contractor regarding the alleged unauthorized use of soil on the Mumbai Coastal Road project. The notice was served to L&T-HCC, a joint venture involved in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Kochi Mini Cooper Crash Kills Three Students, Sparks Outrage
item.description: A Mini Cooper car crashed in Kochi, killing three students. The incident led to outrage after reports emerged that the driver, described as a "VIP brat," allegedly told people at the scene that his father would "handle it." The FIR… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Education Ministry Forms Panel to Investigate IIIT Ranchi Student Death
item.description: The Union Ministry of Education has formed a three-member committee to investigate the death of a student at the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) in Ranchi, Jharkhand. The ministry has taken cognizance of the incident and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 3.

item.title: BJP MPs petition President over sexual harassment allegations against Congress MP
item.description: A group of Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) women Members of Parliament met with President Droupadi Murmu to request the suspension of Congress MP Bimol Akoijam. The petition concerns allegations of sexual harassment against Akoijam. The BJP… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Zelenskyy Claims Partners Failed to Warn of Kyiv Missile Strike
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine did not receive advance warning from its partners regarding a Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv. The attack resulted in five missiles hitting civilian infrastructure… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Anti-drug activist shot dead by medical store owner in Punjab
item.description: Anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh alias Jhota was shot dead by a medical store owner in Mansa, Punjab. The incident occurred when Jhota was questioning the owner about the sale of certain drugs and recording the argument on his mobile… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 4.

item.title: Arms and ammunition found in Poonch militant hideout
item.description: Security forces discovered a militant hideout in the Sawjian sector of Poonch, Jammu and Kashmir, recovering arms and ammunition. The recovered items include an AK-47 rifle and six hand grenades. An investigation into the matter is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka Minister Orders Review of Bengaluru Police Action on Protesters
item.description: Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge has ordered a review of the Bengaluru police's handling of anti-SIR (Strategic Interventions and Reforms) protesters who were detained on Monday. The review follows allegations that police forcibly… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Files FIRs Amidst Manipur Violence Probe
item.description: The Delhi Police has registered four First Information Reports (FIRs) in connection with the ongoing violence in Manipur. Investigations are focusing on individuals spreading rumors and social media accounts, including those from Pakistan… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court to hear plea challenging immunity for Election Commissioners
item.description: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a plea challenging the lifelong immunity granted to the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and other Election Commissioners. The court issued a notice to the Union government and the Election Commission… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Killer of Molly Ticehurst Plans Appeal Against 28-Year Sentence
item.description: The killer of Molly Ticehurst is planning to appeal his 28-year sentence. Ticehurst's father has expressed dismay at the prospect of an appeal, stating "He's got a hide." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court to Hear Trump Admin's Plea on Withholding DOGE Records
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has agreed to hear a plea from the Trump administration seeking to withhold internal documents related to Dogecoin (DOGE). The administration's request concerns records that could potentially be linked to Elon Musk. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Philippine VP Sara Duterte Faces Dropped Impeachment Charges
item.description: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte had most impeachment charges against her dropped by the Philippine Senate, sitting as an impeachment court, on Tuesday. Prosecutors had presented evidence for weeks supporting the charges, which could… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Four killed in Poonch LoC blast, identities disputed
item.description: Four people were killed in an IED or landmine blast on the Line of Control in Poonch district of Jammu & Kashmir; the explosion killed four individuals from the Pakistan‑occupied side and security was heightened afterwards, while reports… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: US, Japan Review Troop Conduct Rules After Okinawa Killing
item.description: Japanese and U.S. officials are reviewing the off-base code of conduct for U.S. troops stationed in Japan. The review follows the alleged killing of an Okinawan woman by a U.S. Marine. Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi stated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Maldivian Pilots Detained in UAE Over Alleged Hijacking Plot
item.description: Two Maldivian pilots have been detained in the United Arab Emirates in connection with an alleged plot to down a flydubai aircraft. The flight, FZ1073, was en route from Dubai to Tel Aviv with 174 passengers and crew when the alleged… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Man Dies After Falling From Six Flags Roller Coaster in Georgia
item.description: A man died after falling from the Goliath roller coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia. Several other people were injured in the incident. Following the fatality, Six Flags temporarily closed nine roller coasters across six amusement parks… Coverage: Left 7 · Centre 18 · Right 4.

item.title: Cyberattack Shuts Down Refrigeration in Hundreds of French Supermarkets
item.description: Hundreds of French supermarkets experienced a widespread refrigeration shutdown due to a cyberattack. The overnight hack targeted the stores' cooling systems, causing fridges to reach temperatures as high as 50°C. This led to the spoilage… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 11 · Right 0.

item.title: MI5 Chief Warns Iran Expanding UK Target Scope to Military Sites
item.description: Britain's domestic security service, MI5, has warned that Iran is expanding its targeting of UK military sites, a shift described as "not unique" by MI5 Chief Ken McCallum. McCallum stated in an annual speech that Tehran's "ambitions" have… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: CJP activists detained near Jantar Mantar; founder criticizes action
item.description: Delhi Police detained Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ajinkya Shinde, associated with the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), near Jantar Mantar. CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke criticized the detentions, questioning if hoisting the national flag at… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: FIRs Filed After Opposition March Demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Resignation
item.description: Two First Information Reports (FIRs) were registered following an opposition march in New Delhi on October 10, which demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. The march was part of a protest against the… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 9 · Right 5.

item.title: Retailer TFG London hit by cyber-attack, customer data potentially exposed
item.description: TFG London, the owner of fashion brands Hobbs, Phase Eight, and Whistles, has reported a cybersecurity incident affecting its websites and IT systems. The company stated on Sunday that the attack may have compromised customers' personal… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Jury selection begins in Buffalo supermarket shooting hate crimes trial
item.description: Jury selection commenced Tuesday for the federal hate crimes trial of the gunman who killed 10 people at a supermarket in Buffalo, New York, in 2022. The trial could result in the white supremacist receiving the death penalty. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Russia Accused of Pressuring Scientist's Family Amid Plague Concerns
item.description: Russia has been accused of pressuring the family of a deceased plague scientist to remain silent, according to reports. Concerns are also rising regarding a suspected case of pneumonic plague in Russia. The scientist reportedly died from… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: SpaceX Agrees to Testify on AI Safety After NYC Council Subpoena
item.description: SpaceX has agreed to testify before the New York City Council regarding AI safety concerns, following the issuance of a subpoena. The council had sought testimony from the company on the matter. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: MI5 Chief Warns of AI-Enabled Terror Attacks and Russian Election Interference
item.description: The head of Britain's domestic security service, MI5, has issued warnings regarding two distinct threats. He cautioned that artificial intelligence will likely make it easier to launch terror attacks on the UK. Separately, he addressed… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Second Man Jailed for Sycamore Gap Tree Felling Released Early
item.description: A second man, who was jailed for his role in felling the Sycamore Gap tree, has been released from prison. The tree, a well-known landmark, was cut down in September 2023. One report indicates he was released early from his sentence. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
